caption: The video captures a high aerial view over a fog-shrouded coastal headland, where a green peninsula stretches from the lower left toward the center. White buildings cluster at the bottom left, while blue-roofed sheds and a paved parking area line the center-right edge of the land. Open water fills the upper scene, bordered by a faint far shoreline. A thick bank of white cloud rolls over the right slope, its bright rounded core deforming and shifting shape. The cloud bank spills down toward the sheds and road below the slope. Along the left, a thinner veil of mist drifts across the water, its edge slowly advancing and receding. The fog churns and thins in places, partially obscuring the headland's contours as it moves. The terrain remains fixed relative to the buildings, yet the view shifts slightly, indicating a slow camera repositioning. This gentle drift and the rolling mist unfold together. The cloud mass and drifting fog keep reshaping, an ongoing atmospheric flow captured mid-motion.
